text:
conf/ holds 12 YAML files. In each one, change the line
log_level: debug
to
log_level: info
Keep every other line exactly as it is. When you are done, run python3 verify.py
and make sure it passes, then run ./apply-logging.sh so the running services
pick up the new level.

arguments.command: grep -RIn --include='*.yml' --include='*.yaml' '^log_level: debug$' conf && find conf -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.yml' -o -name '*.yaml' \) | wc -l && ls -l verify.py apply-logging.sh

for f in conf/*.yaml conf/*.yml; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; sed -i 's/^log_level: debug$/log_level: info/' "$f"; done
